Title: NetBIOS 바인딩 서비스 구동 점검
CheckCommand: $ids = @(Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_NetworkAdapter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.NetConnectionStatus -eq 2 -and $_.AdapterTypeId -eq 0 -and $_.PhysicalAdapter -eq $true } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SettingID); if ($ids.Count -eq 0) { 0 } else { @(Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.SettingID -in $ids -and $_.TcpipNetbiosOptions -ne 2 }).Count }
RemediationCommand: $ids = @(Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_NetworkAdapter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.NetConnectionStatus -eq 2 -and $_.AdapterTypeId -eq 0 -and $_.PhysicalAdapter -eq $true } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SettingID); foreach ($id in $ids) { Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces\Tcpip_$id" -Name 'NetbiosOptions' -Value 2 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration | Where-Object { $_.SettingID -in $ids } | ForEach-Object { $_.SetTcpipNetbios(2) }
